mentions.name: ContributorIQ
mentions.description: This tool supports the M&A due diligence process by quickly identifying the subject matter experts (SMEs) for specific parts of a codebase.
mentions.problem: During M&A due diligence, teams need to quickly understand who the SMEs are in specific parts of a codebase.
mentions.audience: People involved in M&A due diligence
